def execute_anti_mage_mana_void_dota(ctx, actor, target, cfg):
    # LORE INTENT: Detonates damage around an enemy based on the mana that enemy is missing.
    if not ctx.owns_ability(actor, ability_id): return NOT_OWNED
    if not ctx.check_explicit_conditions(actor, target, cfg): return DENIED
    tx = ctx.begin_effect(ability_id, actor, target)
    center = determine_impact_or_cast_center(actor,target)
    targets = unique_targets_in_radius(center,radius)
    for entity in targets:
        strength = compute_optional_distance_falloff(entity,center)
        apply_named_impact_knockback_or_damage(entity,strength)
    spawn_one_off_environment_visual(center)
    tx.commit_if_valid()
    ctx.emit_effect_event(ability_id)
    return SUCCESS
